items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: actually was a guy who played piano for us at Carnegie Hall with the Catatonic Five

ctx.x: That’s a great story, and you had great motivation to learn the music because you had, hopefully, a spot to go for it.
So that all sort of fell together. And I can remember that first night I was at Hamilton I heard somebody over at what we used to call Silliman Hall playing the piano, and it was Derry Hall.
